title: Prioritize normal MyCAREER / online rewards before exploits
summary: VC can be earned through supported NBA 2K26 gameplay and MyCAREER/online activities. Use this as the baseline safe route.

title: Track endorsement/quest routes by VC per minute
summary: Record total VC and elapsed time for endorsement/quest runs; the app ranks VC/hour from your own observed results instead of inventing a universal payout.

title: Claim daily/recurring rewards before grinding
summary: Check daily/recurring rewards first because they consume little play time; the optimizer treats them as high VC-per-minute when available.

title: VC glitches/exploits are tracked but isolated
summary: Exploit reports can be listed for research, but they are never ranked above safe methods by default. Verify current patch status before considering them.

title: Button shooting remains a strong baseline
summary: NBA2KLab testing found button shooting largely unchanged in the cited rhythm-shooting patch comparison. Choose the input you can repeat consistently.

title: Rhythm shooting needs consistent push + tempo
summary: Rhythm shooting has two timing dimensions: push timing and tempo. Practice a repeatable tempo rather than chasing random visual timing.

title: Practice rhythm tempo around the measured green zone
summary: NBA2KLab practice tooling currently targets roughly 35–60ms tempo; treat this as a practice target, not a guarantee of a make.

title: Re-check rhythm timing after patches
summary: Patch changes can tighten rhythm windows. Recalibrate after major shooting patches instead of reusing old timing blindly.

title: Jumpshot animation + distance can shift the green window
summary: NBA2KLab reports the timing window can shift with animation and shot distance. Pick a jumper you can recognize consistently from your common spots.

title: Choose dribble animations from the full catalog, then filter by build
summary: 2K26 Animation Glossary is intended to list animations with attribute and height requirements. The app keeps the master catalog separate from eligibility.

title: Use height/attribute requirements to find SGA-style movement
summary: NBA2KW publishes animation requirements by category, including Dribble Style and other ball-handling packages.

title: Protect spacing before forcing a shot
summary: Online win advice: maintain usable spacing, avoid crowding the ball-handler, and preserve passing lanes. Mode-specific recommendations are weighted in Build Intelligence.

title: Do not burn all stamina before the scoring action
summary: Reserve stamina for the final move, acceleration or defensive recovery. The optimizer can prioritize Speed/Agility/SWB thresholds when relevant.

title: Perimeter defense + agility are high-value for two-way wings
summary: For a 6'8 wing, perimeter defense and agility affect multiple defensive badge/animation gates and practical recovery.

title: Measure VC/hour on your own account
summary: Enter starting VC, ending VC and elapsed minutes. The app calculates observed VC/hour and ranks methods by your real results.

title: Spend VC on meaningful thresholds, not arbitrary +1s
summary: The optimizer looks for badge, animation and build-cap thresholds before recommending an upgrade. If the next +1 unlocks nothing, it can recommend saving VC.

title: Upgrade for your target mode, not a generic rating
summary: Offline, Rec, Theater and 1v1 have different priorities. The optimizer re-ranks attributes by selected mode and role.

title: Plan VC around Cap Breaker ceilings
summary: Cap Breakers can raise attributes but body measurements can cap potential, and up to five can be applied to one attribute. Plan permanent VC spending around the post-Cap ceiling.

title: Search every jumper by name before deciding
summary: Public 2K26 jumper lists contain hundreds of player packages across height bands. The Companion keeps the full master list and filters it by current build.

title: Height is part of jumper eligibility
summary: NBA2K26 jumper availability is segmented by height. The app evaluates both shooting rating and height before marking a jumper eligible.

title: Master jumper data is never filtered away
summary: A build switch should only change ELIGIBLE/LOCKED status. It must never delete a jumper from the master catalog.

title: Keep patched exploits in history
summary: The database archives exploit/glitch reports after patches so users can see what changed without treating patched methods as active recommendations.

title: Never mix exploit methods into SAFE rankings
summary: Exploit/glitch records can be viewed, but the normal optimizer excludes BAN RISK methods unless the user explicitly enables the risk filter.

title: Re-sync after every gameplay patch
summary: Animation, shooting and exploit status can change after patches. The app checks source tables and archives changes.

title: Keep source conflicts visible
summary: When public sources disagree, the app preserves both evidence records and labels the conflict instead of silently guessing.
